title: Treasury Standard: The Instant Payout Amount on a Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
The instant payout amount of a Pocketwire Business Profile is computed from the balance cleared for an instant payout.

**Balance.** The business balance is the balance recorded on the profile. The instant payout amount is worked out only after the business balance carries the subscription fee entry for the current calendar month, on a tier that charges a monthly subscription and in a month the waiver rule does not waive.

**Holds counted against an instant payout.** The holds counted against an instant payout are the amount of every hold entry on the profile less the amount of every hold release entry on it.

**Sales of the handling date.** The sales dated on the handling date are the sales from which the sales still settling on the handling date are taken.

**The month's gross sales.** The gross sales dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

**Reserve and keep-back amounts.**
- The instant claims reserve is the instant claims reserve percentage of the gross sales dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date, rounded to the nearest cent.
- The instant cross-border keep-back is the instant cross-border keep-back percentage of the international sales dated within that rolling month, rounded to the nearest cent.
- The fee keep-back is the tier's maximum instant payout fee, kept back so the payout's own fee can be booked.

**Balance cleared for an instant payout.** The balance cleared for an instant payout is the business balance less the holds counted against an instant payout, the sales still settling on the handling date, the instant claims reserve, the instant cross-border keep-back, the instant advance keep-back, the instant velocity keep-back and the tier's maximum instant payout fee, all taken from that one balance.

**Instant payout amount.** The instant payout amount is the instant share of the cleared balance capped at the tier's maximum amount of one instant payout and at the tier's daily payout limit less the payouts already dated on the handling date, never below zero, and rounded to the nearest cent.

**Plain case.** With every sale dated on the handling date counted as still settling, the tier's maximum instant payout fee as the only keep-back, and the whole cleared balance as the instant share, the amount is the business balance less the holds counted, less every sale dated on the handling date and less the tier's maximum instant payout fee; what remains, never below zero, is paid out in full to the cent within the tier's maximum amount of one instant payout and within the daily payout limit less the payouts already dated on the handling date.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs, plain case)

Business balance USD 3000.00; hold entries USD 650.00 and hold release entries USD 250.00, so holds counted USD 400.00; sales dated on the handling date USD 250.00; maximum instant payout fee USD 25.00; cleared balance USD 2325.00. With a maximum of one instant payout of USD 2500.00, a daily payout limit of USD 5000.00 and USD 3000.00 already paid out on the handling date, the daily room is USD 2000.00, so the instant payout amount is USD 2000.00.
